Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.

2. Learned counsel for respondent No.1 is present and submits that against the order passed in MVC No.1129/2011 dated 31.07.2013, previously another appeal was filed in MFA No.481/2014 and the same was settled in the Lok-Adalat on 08.04.2017.
3.
Prior to the aforesaid order, this appeal is filed.
As the appeal i.e., MFA No.481/2014 filed against the order passed in MVC No.1129/2011, was already settled before the Lok-Adalat, this appeal does not survive for consideration.
4. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as infructuous.
